* '''Original''' (this page): the Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet prints only a game-text slip for the Decipher card ••Floating Refinery, so the card keeps that title, two-dot uniqueness and lore<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_4.pdf Virtual Block 7.4 release sheet] ("Official text as of December 16, 2011"; PDF dated 19 December 2011, the same file the Players Committee site offered in February 2012). Your Force generation is +1 at cloud sectors you occupy. Once during your control phase, if you occupy this sector, may draw destiny. If destiny > 2, retrieve 1 Force. If lost from table, place this device in Used Pile.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p2-132-Tibanna_Floating_Refinery.png]]) prints it. The PC website card list (in every capture from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013, as “Floating Refinery (V)”) showed the same text, with “Device” capitalized<ref name="cl-1274_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11]</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tibanna Floating Refinery (V)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints a full slip titled •Tibanna Floating Refinery (unique), with the same lore, the deployment limit removed and “and a battleground site” added<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a cloud sector. Your Force generation is +1 at cloud sectors you occupy. Once during your control phase, if you occupy this sector and a battleground site, may draw destiny. If destiny > 2, retrieve 1 Force. If lost from table, place this device in Used Pile.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1274-4-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-tibannafloatingrefinery-pre.gif]]) print it.
